claim_citation.quote: In despair, he creates a construct of his dead little sister, Ellie, to calm his mother.

candidates.summary: The most insane construct in the set: John creates a realistic dead-sister construct to comfort his dementia-stricken mother. This is a temporary, emotionally targeted construct that later becomes an ongoing autonomous presence in the run.
candidates.title: Dead-sister construct Ellie
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests Ellie as a lifelike construct and presents her to his mother as a comforting companion.

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart decided to build a sniper rifle construct that was so precise and deadly that it only took one shot to thwart the threat from such a long distance.

candidates.summary: Assisted/weapon construct. John forms a sniper rifle with enough precision to make a single, long-range disabling shot.
candidates.title: Green Lantern Corps
candidates.what_visibly_happens: He manifests a rifle, sights the target at extreme range, and fires one precise shot.

claim_citation.quote: The alternate Green Lantern immediately re-creates the old ghetto buildings, repairing them in the process.

candidates.summary: A straightforward but still impressive full-block reconstruction: John rapidly rebuilds multiple destroyed buildings after the Key’s bomb damage. This is a completed, visible feat rather than a failed attempt.
candidates.title: Rebuilds an entire damaged city block after the Key’s bombs
candidates.what_visibly_happens: After the Key’s bombs destroy numerous buildings, John immediately restores the old ghetto buildings and repairs them on the spot.

claim_citation.quote: John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: A brutally specialized construct: John builds a precision sniper rifle and uses it to kill a living planet. This is one of his most extreme and tactically elaborate construct uses, though it is not a failed attempt.
candidates.title: Constructs a sniper rifle to kill Mogo
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John forms a sniper rifle construct, aims into Mogo’s core, and fires the shot that kills the living planet.

claim_citation.quote: John initially chooses Larfleeze's orange ring but is convinced by Hal to use Indigo-1's ring instead due to the debilitating effects of the orange ring on the wearer’s psyche.

candidates.summary: This is a temporary, assisted power-use case rather than a pure John-built construct, so it is less of a construct feat than the others. It is included because the retrieved context supports John using borrowed ring power in a high-stakes failure/constraint scenario.
candidates.title: Temporarily channels another Corps ring during War of the Green Lanterns
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John takes up the Indigo ring after considering the Orange ring, then struggles to channel multiple Corps powers while fighting corrupted Lanterns and Mogo.
